declared_before: any product, label, event count, feature or prediction of the 2026-10-27..2026-11-01 data was computed; only file sizes and SHA-256 had been read
raw_device: main device only; Voltage Sample excluded from training, normalization, calibration and evaluation
code_origin: v1 prepare_data/build_windows/lifetime_labels, v2 prepare_v2, v3 prepare_v3/risk_models/life_models, regenerated by make_tree.py with asserted edits only

label_rules.product: unchanged: spray mean voltage <51 V; active-hopper feed mean outside 9.1-11.1 g/min; active-hopper pressure mean outside 100-250 mbar
label_rules.company_corrections: unchanged: P003507 not failed; R009 ordinary wait; R011 retained as weak endpoint
label_rules.new_week: same automatic rules; NO company review exists for 2026-10-27..11-01, so every new candidate is rule-inferred only
label_rules.unknown_products: truncate follow-up; never counted as normal
label_rules.natural_failure_supervision: weak interval-censored low-voltage-stop/recovery proxies; zero individually confirmed natural failures
label_rules.risk_target_time: first failed product START within 300 s; two observed normal products resolve an episode

leakage_controls.risk_split: expanding time-forward folds; training rows end 3900 s before the cut (product result availability), validation starts 10800 s after it (maximum feature history)
leakage_controls.preprocessing: imputation, scaling, auxiliary heads, calibration and thresholds fit on each fold's training/earlier out-of-fold rows only
leakage_controls.life_split: whole possible electrode cycles; a cycle is used for training only when it lies entirely before the evaluated cycle; cycle identity is inferred, not confirmed

risk_folds.name: f4
risk_folds.status: dates already inspected by earlier rounds

risk_folds.name: f5
risk_folds.status: dates already inspected by earlier rounds

risk_folds.name: f6
risk_folds.status: BLIND: unseen by every earlier round

risk_selection.rule: frozen v3 choices from September forward folds (development_freeze.json); NOT re-selected using October or the new week

neural_models: not rerun: TCN/GRU/Patch Transformer/SSL-TCN ranked below the tree models on v3 forward folds for voltage and were never trained for the other two tasks; the server has no CUDA Python stack and 15 GB free disk

simple_baselines.prevalence: constant score; its AP equals the positive-window rate
simple_baselines.last_product_rule: no training: voltage 51-V_last; feedrate max(9.1-F_last, F_last-11.1); pressure max(100-P_last, P_last-250), from the last completed product available at the landmark
simple_baselines.logistic: regularised logistic regression on the same 292 features

alarm_policy: two consecutive 10 s landmarks above threshold, 300 s cooldown; threshold maximises event recall under <=20 false alarms per 100 observable powered hours on earlier out-of-fold predictions; experimental budget, not a site-approved tolerance

blind_evaluation.old_v3_isolated: v3 models/<task>/risk/<selected>/final (trained <=2026-09-29) with its frozen v3 calibration and threshold
blind_evaluation.old_v3_full_refit: v3 models/full_data/<task> (trained <=2026-10-23); the v3 report attached no validation score to it; scored with the frozen v3 calibration and threshold of the same algorithm
blind_evaluation.v4_f6: v4 pipeline refit on <=2026-10-23; calibration and threshold from pooled out-of-fold f1-f5 only
blind_evaluation.baselines: thresholds from out-of-fold f1-f5 scores only
primary_metrics: events alarmed before the first failed product starts
false alarms per 100 observable powered hours
blind_evaluation.limit: one week on one device; event counts are expected to be single digits, so differences between models are descriptive, not statistically established

final_refit.validation_scores: none apply: the final refit has seen every available date

life.evaluation: cycle-forward folds; blind: models fit on partitions 0-3 scored on partition 4; old v3 full_data life model scored on partition 4
life.metrics: distance of the predicted median to the weak endpoint interval; fraction of censored windows whose predicted median is below the already-observed survival time
life.limit: weak proxy endpoints only; interval quantiles are not calibrated lifetime confidence intervals

comparison_caveat: v1, v2 and v3 used different targets, splits and alarm rules, so their published scores are not one benchmark; only scores computed in this run on the same rows are directly comparable
